settings.tab_content: 100% Mongolian baby cashmere harvested during springtime combing. Fiber diameter is limited to 13.5 microns for supreme softness.
Hand-cut and fully canvassed by master tailors. Shoulder seams are reinforced with silk thread for structural memory.
Dry clean only. Store flat in the provided cedar box with natural lavender sachets. Avoid hanging to maintain shoulder form.
Delivered by courier in custom heavy-duty garment boxes with cedar hangers and silk dust bags.
